## Before submitting

- [x] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes.
- [x] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the `AGENTS.md` for each directory this PR touches (see [root AGENTS.md § Reviewing a PR](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/AGENTS.md#reviewing-a-pr-human-or-agent)) and my changes comply, or I explain the exception below.
- [ ] I added GitHub labels: one `cat-*`, one or more `area:*` / `op:*`, and one `orig-*` (see [label list](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/labels)). I cannot set labels on this repository; suggested: `orig-external`, `cat-bugfix`, `area:sparse_attention`.

## Affected area

CI or test infrastructure

## Summary

`test_sm120_fp8_blk128_dsl_gate_precedes_quantizer_import` called `bsa_fp8_blk128_fwd(object(), object(), object(), object(), 1)` to prove that the SM120 CuTe DSL version gate raises before any operand is read or the quantizer is imported. Since `bsa_fp8_blk128_fwd` became the shared SM90 / SM100/SM103 / SM120 entry, its first statement is `_get_device_arch_for_device(q.device.index)`, so on SM120 the test fails with `AttributeError: 'object' object has no attribute 'device'` before reaching the gate.

Q is now a one-element CUDA tensor; K, V and the block index stay `object()`. The architecture dispatch can read Q's device, and the test still proves what it was written for: on SM120 the gate (`_require_sage_fp8_cutedsl`) raises before K, V or the index is touched and before `_fp8_quant` is imported. Test-only change.

## Why

The test only runs on SM120 (`_require_sm120()`), so the regression shows up only on an SM120 job.

## Related issues

None filed; found while rerunning the SM120 suites for #1156.

## API and compatibility impact

None.

## Testing

RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell (cc 12.0), develop `4cd4e613`, CUDA 13 driver R580, torch 2.14.1+cu130, cuDNN 9.27.0, CuTe DSL 4.8.1, `CUDNN_FRONTEND_ENABLE_FROST_ENGINES=1`, from `test/python`:

| Command | develop | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| `python -m pytest "block_sparse_attention/cutedsl/test_BSA_attention_fp8_sm120.py::test_sm120_fp8_blk128_dsl_gate_precedes_quantizer_import"` | 1 failed (`AttributeError`) | 1 passed |
| `python -m pytest -m "L0 or L1" block_sparse_attention/cutedsl/test_BSA_attention_fp8_sm120.py` | | 26 passed |

The branch is rebased on `fe8c5812`; neither the test file nor `_interface.py` changed in between. In the same run the 13 SM120 SDPA/BSA suite files gave 1520 passed / 13 skipped at L0 and 712 passed at L1, with this test the only failure.

detail.title: test(bsa): pass a CUDA query to the SM120 FP8 blk128 DSL-gate test

files.patch:
@@ -329,8 +329,11 @@ def test_sm120_fp8_blk128_dsl_gate_precedes_quantizer_import(monkeypatch):
     _require_sm120()
     interface = importlib.import_module("cudnn.block_sparse_attention._interface")
     monkeypatch.setattr(interface.cutlass, "__version__", "4.6.0")
+    # The entry dispatches on Q's device first (SM90 / SM100 / SM120 share it); the remaining
+    # operands stay opaque, so the SM120 DSL gate must still raise before any of them is read.
+    q = torch.empty((1,), device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
     with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match=r"requires nvidia-cutlass-dsl>=4\.6\.1"):
-        interface.bsa_fp8_blk128_fwd(object(), object(), object(), object(), 1)
+        interface.bsa_fp8_blk128_fwd(q, object(), object(), object(), 1)
 
 
 @pytest.mark.L0
